harbour-space.shortDescription: The Harbour.Space blog built with Next.js and Strapi.
harbour-space.description: I worked on the blog's main pages and contributed to its migration to Next.js, initiated to improve SEO. Blog content is managed in Strapi, with the backend developed collaboratively.
harbour-space.contribution: I built the blog's main pages and initiated the Next.js migration for SEO. I also worked with the team on the Strapi backend; my contribution to the project was approximately 40%.

seafood-shop.shortDescription: Catalog, cart, and checkout for a headless storefront.
seafood-shop.description: I worked on the frontend of a Headless Bitrix store: the catalog, product cards, cart, and checkout. The project used Next.js 14→15, React 18/19 RC, and SSR/RSC.
seafood-shop.contribution: I worked on the catalog, product cards, cart, and checkout, as well as the Next.js 14→15 update and server-rendered flows.
